author: reactive-end
summary: Fixed: test-tampering checks in `anvil check` and the Stop gate read `git diff HEAD`, which leaves out untracked files, so a new test file with it.skip( passed. New git::pending_diffs adds untracked files as new-file diffs (up to 1 MB), and the review packet reuses it. Two benchmark cases added: an untracked skipped test (caught) and an untracked clean test (silent). Verified: the old binary passed the case and the new one fails it.
evidence: old binary PASS vs new binary [ERROR] no-test-tampering on untracked tests/a.test.ts; slop_bench 32 cases ok; 459 tests; clippy, fmt, anvil check PASS
